items.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 1st STAGE
items.description: The beginning of the seventh story arc in the long-running JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series. It’s 1890, in America, the Steel Ball Run — the first horse racing championship across the North American continent — was about to begin. Johnny Joestar, once being hailed as a genius jockey, is now paralysed and lost in despair. He finds hope in the mysterious phenomena caused by Gyro Zeppeli, an outlaw aiming to win the race, and determines to participate in the 4,000 miles of grueling adventure.

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Parte 7: Steel Ball Run
items.description_es:
En el Viejo Oeste americano, la carrera más grande del mundo está a punto de comenzar. Miles de personas hacen fila en San Diego para viajar más de seis mil kilómetros y tener la oportunidad de ganar el gran premio de cincuenta millones de dólares. Con la era del caballo llegando a su fin, los concursantes pueden utilizar cualquier tipo de vehículo que deseen. Los competidores tendrán que soportar condiciones agotadoras, viajando hasta cien kilómetros por día a través de páramos inexplorados. Steel Ball Run es verdaderamente un evento único en su tipo.

El joven Johnny Joestar, un ex corredor de caballos lisiado, ha venido a San Diego para presenciar el inicio de la carrera. Allí se encuentra con Gyro Zeppeli, un corredor con dos bolas de acero en la cintura en lugar de una pistola. Johnny es testigo de cómo Gyro usa una de sus bolas de acero para desatar un poder fantástico, lo que obliga a un hombre a dispararse a sí mismo durante un duelo. En medio de la acción, Johnny toca la bola de acero y siente un poder surgiendo a través de sus piernas, lo que le permite ponerse de pie por primera vez en dos años. Prometiendo encontrar el secreto de las bolas de acero, Johnny decide competir en la carrera y así comienza su extraña aventura por todo Estados Unidos en Steel Ball Run.

items.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season
items.description: The third season of Kusuriya no Hitorigoto . In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

items.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
items.description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you.. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

items.title: Mahoutsukai no Yoru
items.description: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.
items.title_japanese: 魔法使いの夜
items.description_es: Ambientada cerca del final del período Showa, a finales de la década de 1980, se rumorea que una antigua mansión en la ciudad de Misaki es el hogar de una bruja. Aoko ingresa abruptamente al mundo de los magos después de que su abuelo de repente decide que Aoko se convierta en la sucesora de la familia Aozaki. Desde entonces, Aoko se muda a la Mansión Kuonji y comienza a aprender hechicería de la joven maga Alice Kuonji, la rumoreada bruja de la mansión. Después de presenciar a los dos usando magia, Soujuurou Shizuki también se ve obligado a vivir con ellos hasta que se descubre una runa para eliminar sus recuerdos.

items.title: Kagurabachi
items.description: Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.
items.title_japanese: カグラバチ
items.description_es: El joven Chihiro pasa sus días entrenando con su famoso padre herrero. Algún día espera convertirse él mismo en un gran fabricante de espadas. El padre tonto y el hijo serio... pensaron que estos días durarían para siempre. Pero, de repente, sobreviene la tragedia. Un día oscuro empapado de sangre. Chihiro y su espada ahora viven sólo para vengarse.

items.title: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Dear Friend no Yume wo Minai
items.description: Theatrical follow-up to Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai . "Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima." The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve. Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another. The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality. ―Stop Touko Kirishima, ―Before reality is rewritten. To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".

Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad...

items.title: THE RIBBON HERO
items.description: Princess Sapphire of the lost kingdom. Stripped of everything in her homeland, Silverland, by the calamity known as "Nergal," she arrived in Goldland at the very depths of despair. While carrying the weight of her past, she began to find a glimmer of hope through the kindness of the people. Yet, as if mocking her peaceful daily life, the calamity "Nergal" appears once more. The same despair that reduced her homeland to ashes is now threatening to steal the light from this land as well. "No more loss for me. No more loss for anyone.” Wiping way her fears of sorrow, the young girl takes up her sword. This is the story of a hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy fate. Note: This anime is inspired by Osamu Tezuka's manga "Princess Knight”.
items.title_japanese: THE RIBBON HERO
items.description_es: Princesa Zafiro del reino perdido. Despojada de todo lo que había en su tierra natal, Silverland, por la calamidad conocida como "Nergal", llegó a Goldland en lo más profundo de la desesperación. Mientras cargaba con el peso de su pasado, empezó a encontrar un rayo de esperanza en la bondad de la gente. Sin embargo, como burlándose de su pacífica vida cotidiana, la calamidad "Nergal" aparece una vez más. La misma desesperación que redujo su tierra natal a cenizas ahora amenaza con robarle también la luz a esta tierra. "No más pérdidas para mí. No más pérdidas para nadie". Limpiando sus temores de tristeza, la joven toma su espada. Esta es la historia de una heroína que se ata la cinta y decide desafiar al destino. Nota: Este anime está inspirado en el manga "Princess Knight" de Osamu Tezuka.

items.title: Wareware wa Uchuujin
items.description: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Kyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart. Spanning more than thirty years, this gentle, contemplative story invites the audience to reflect on the meaning of life through the paths their lives take.
items.title_japanese: 我々は宇宙人
items.description_es: Un verano en tercer grado, un niño tranquilo llamado Tsubasa conoce a Kyotaro, un niño al que todos en la clase admiraban, y los dos se hacen amigos cercanos. Dentro de su pequeño mundo, comparten momentos irremplazables, hasta que un pequeño incidente los separa de repente. A lo largo de más de treinta años, esta historia amable y contemplativa invita al público a reflexionar sobre el significado de la vida a través de los caminos que toma.

items.title: Shiranuhi
items.description: The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse. Note: Initially teased at AnimeJapan 2024 in the CoMix Wave Films booth, a visual of this project was shown off with a description being a new animation project by a "rookie director".
items.title_japanese: しらぬひ
items.description_es: El corto está ambientado en una ciudad costera de Kumamoto a finales del verano de 1996. Minato, un niño de 10 años, vive una vida precaria con su padre borracho. La única fuente de fuerza de Minato es Ben-chan, una diosa con forma de niña que apareció en la isla Benten. El tiempo que pasa con ella son los únicos momentos en los que se siente como él mismo. Pero cuando está a punto de ser separado de Ben-chan debido a que lo enviarán a un hogar para niños, Minato le reza a un Shiranuhi, una luz misteriosa que flota sobre el mar, para que le conceda un deseo. Su deseo, lleno de odio hacia su padre, acaba convirtiéndose en una maldición.
